'''Business and economy'''
*[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] announces the cancellation of Phase 2 of the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[High-speed rail|high-speed rail]] project [[High Speed 2]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-67001483 (BBC News)]
*Over 75,000 workers from [[Kaiser Permanente]], an [[integrated managed care]] [[consortium]] in the [[United States]], go on [[Strike action|strike]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/04/health/kaiser-permanente-strike-health-care.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The gap between [[Italy]] and [[Germany]]'s 10 year bond yields increases by 200.2 basis points. Italy comes under intensifying pressure to sell off the public assets. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/ecbs-knot-says-italy-is-paying-price-higher-deficit-2023-10-06/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Sikkim flash floods]]
**At least 14 people are killed and 100 others are missing after a [[cloudburst]] causes severe flooding in [[Sikkim]], [[India]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/10/05/india/india-sikkim-floods-search-damage-climate-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**The [[Lhonak Lake]] bursts its banks, causing major flooding and impacting 22,000 people. It its the worst such disaster in the region in over 50 years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/fourteen-dead-102-missing-after-indian-glacial-lake-bursts-bank-heavy-rain-2023-10-05/ (Reuters)]
** Large parts of the [[Teesta Barrage|Teesta Dam]] have been washed away, with multiple large bridges also being destroyed. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2492939-zoektocht-naar-tientallen-vermisten-bij-overstromingen-india (NOS)]

'''Health and environment'''
*In his [[Apostolic exhortation|exhortation]] ''[[Laudate Deum]]'', [[Pope Francis]] speaks out against [[climate change denial]] and in favor of fighting the [[climate crisis]]. [https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/en/apost_exhortations/documents/20231004-laudate-deum.html (Vatican)]

'''International relations'''
*The [[United States]] and [[Russia]] test their [[emergency population warning]] systems. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-conduct-emergency-public-warning-tests-wednesday-2023-10-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]]n journalist [[Marina Ovsyannikova]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to eight and a half years in prison [[Trial in absentia|in absentia]] for interrupting a news broadcast with [[Anti-war protests in Russia (2022–present)|anti-war]] slogans. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-journalist-who-staged-tv-war-protest-handed-8-12-year-jail-term-absentia-2023-10-04/ (Reuters)]
**Around 11 [[anti-war movement|anti-war]] protesters involved with [[Code Pink]] are arrested outside the office of [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] after calling for the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] to bring an end to the war. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/4238832-progressive-activists-bring-ukraine-war-protests-to-congressional-officies/ (''The Hill'')] 

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Moungi Bawendi]], [[Louis E. Brus]], and [[Alexey Ekimov]] are awarded the [[Nobel Prize in Chemistry]] for their work on [[quantum dot]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-67005670 (BBC News)]
*[[Lars Schaade]] is appointed as the new President of the [[Robert Koch Institute]]. [https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/presse/pressemitteilungen/praeventions-institut-im-aufbau-pm-04-10-23.html (Bundesministerium für Gesundheit)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Spain–Portugal–Morocco 2030 FIFA World Cup bid]]
**In [[association football]], [[FIFA]] awards the [[2030 FIFA World Cup]] to [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], and [[Morocco]], making it the first [[FIFA World Cup]] tournament to be hosted in [[North Africa]]. The [[opening ceremony]] will take place in [[Montevideo]], [[Uruguay]], to mark the 100th anniversary of the competition.
